name: flowy-core
description: The Flowy enforcement engine (hook + activator). Overlays depend on this. 1.2.1: overlay activation works on Windows Git Bash again - the engine root arrives as C:/... while the activator writes /c/..., and the three path containment checks that compared them refused every overlay with no error. 1.2.0: activation is addressed to the session that requested it, so two sessions on one repo can no longer claim each other's Flows. 1.1.0: every shipped Flow routes every skill it names, with a state-based trigger and a gate; authoring rules are enforced repo-wide. 1.0.0: RECEIPT-framed routing, so the 'Routing:' line records skills already invoked and writing it can no longer substitute for invoking them.
